description: Add one line: parts with quantity, unit_cost_minor in whole MINOR units and optional markup, or labour with hours and rate_minor. A line on an invoiced order, or dated before the request, is refused.

date.description: The day this line was worked or fitted, YYYY-MM-DD

description.description: What it is, e.g. 3kW immersion element, or Second fix and test

kind.description: parts for materials, labour for time on the job

markup_percent.description: parts only: percent added to the UNIT cost before billing. Default 0

quantity.description: parts only: how many. A negative or zero quantity is refused

rate_minor.description: labour only: the hourly rate in whole minor units. Omit only once the shared business profile carries a default rate

unit_cost_minor.description: parts only: what one costs YOU, in whole minor units. 1299 is EUR 12.99

work_order.description: The work order id, e.g. WO-2026-0001, or the client name when only one job is theirs

name: work_order_add_line
title: Add a parts or labour line
